title: Plugging the reader into ooDialog: in the browser and on Linux
summary: The contract is the comment above resourceProvider in oodialog-wasm's oodWeb.cls. dialogTemplate(library, id) returns 'x y cx cy title opts fontName fontSize controls', and each control is 'kind id x y cx cy text opts'. menuTemplate(library, id) returns records of 'depth id text flags'. In the browser, on 14 Nov 2026, the ooDialog/WASM chat ran integration/oodialog_wasm/t07 unmodified on ooRexx/WASM (oodialog-wasm 05e1fb8, REQ-00003581). All 7 steps passed, and the output equalled the expected file. On Linux, the Qt6 renderer's .JS~resourceProvider offers this reader when WinResources.cls is on REXX_PATH. oodWeb.cls asks for it only with the change proposed in proposals/oodWeb-v0.13.1-linux.patch (see sphere oodialog-linux-qt6, article qt6.oodweb-proposals). With that change, upstream samples that read .dll resources come up on Linux: oowalk2, both TabDemos, and Exercise04's ASimpleDialog2.
invariants: The reader is the consumer's choice: oodWeb never loads it on its own; a program or a renderer sets it.
